notes: Both arms use local and cross-chirp average powers of the observed, coarse and observation-minus-coarse spectral fields, normalized by an inference-time robust outer-frequency power proxy. The extra two per-chirp features are the real and imaginary parts of the same frequency conjugate product, attenuated by the power proxy when either input is uncertain.

Both heads learn a real gain for each chirp and frequency bin. Candidate also learns its quadrature gain from the same input. Each gain vector is divided by sqrt(1+its squared norm) and multiplied by 0.5. It acts only on the complex observation-minus-coarse residual, preserves zero edit at DC, and never averages complex samples across chirps.

The original frozen E104 L_s true CE and confidence-filtered U_s clean pseudo-CE, IQ/spectrum losses and clean consistency keep matching weights. Each arm uses the same initialization and synthetic source draws, extends the fixed budget to 36000 updates, and jointly optimizes coarse and gain. Both readout rules are fixed before any target access.

Full clean plus six registered practical on 30000 paired packets from 15 unseen receivers, one fixed reader seed. After all three shards freeze, an independent local process alone reads target labels. Source scores are a reference.
